question: Ambubachi fair is held every year in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ambubachi Fair **is an annual religious festival held at the **Kamakhya Temple** in **Guwahati, Assam.**
 
• The festival celebrates the menstruation of the goddess Kamakhya and is considered to be a symbol of** fertility and womanhood.**
 
• During the festival, the temple remains closed for **three days **and reopens on the **fourth day, **which is considered to be the most auspicious day.
 
• The fair attracts a large number of **devotees and tourists** from all over the country and is a major cultural event in** Assam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipur **is known for its rich cultural heritage and is famous for its traditional dance forms like **Manipuri and Nata Sankirtana.**

 
 
• Famous festivals of Manipur are the **Yaoshang Festival, Kut Festival, Gang Ngai Festival, Cheiraoba Festival, Kang Rath Yatra, Lui Ngai Ni Festival.**
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is known for its scenic beauty and is home to a diverse range of **tribes and cultures.**
 
 
• Arunachal Pradesh celebrates a number of events, including the** Mopin Festival, the Losar Festival, the Dree Festival of Apatani, Chalo-Loku of Nocte, Solung of Adis, the Ziro Festival of Music, the Pangsau Pass Winter Festival, and Siang River Festival.**
 
 
 
• **Nagaland** is known for its vibrant tribal culture and is famous for its traditional festivals like **Hornbill Festival and Moatsu Festival.**
 
 
• Famous festivals of Nagaland are **The Hornbill Festival, Ngada Festival, Hega Festival, Mim Kut Festival, Bushu Festival, Tsukhenye Festival, Sukrenye Festival and Yemshe Festival.**
